text: 从360集团获悉，近日，在被誉为AI安全“世界杯”的国际权威基准测试CyberGym中，360集团自研的AI安全攻防系统图龙锋以99.4%的漏洞复现成功率登顶榜单并刷新世界纪录。此次同榜竞技的包括OpenAI、Anthropic、Google等全球头部AI厂商的模型与智能体。（上证报）
text_en: According to 360 Group, recently, in CyberGym, an internationally authoritative benchmark test known as the "World Cup" of AI security, 360 Group's self-developed AI security attack and defense system Tulongfeng topped the list with a 99.4% vulnerability reproduction success rate and set a new world record. Competing on the same list were models and agents from global leading AI vendors including OpenAI, Anthropic and Google. (Shanghai Securities News)
